20020.long_desc:
Arcooda Pinball Arcade (Arcooda cabinet version) software is developed in partnership with FarSight Studios, the makers of the number one video pinball software, The Pinball Arcade. It allows you to play pinball games on a full sized video pinball machine with full backglass, DMD, coil, shaker, LED and multi-function support. Arcooda Pinball Arcade contains 76 customized licensed video pinball games which have designed to work of our vertical and horizontal virtual pinball machines. Over 20 months in development, Arcooda Pinball Arcade software offers many advanced features including button or touchscreen play, advanced playfield angles (including 3D options), real pinball parts support (flipper coils, shaker motors), three-screen gameplay for advanced cabinet support and much more. Full details on the software are available below; - 76 Williams, Bally, Gottlieb, Alvin G and FarSight Studios tables are included - supports variable plunger including analog and digital function - supports variable nudge/tilt including analog and digital function - supports 2 or 3 screen virtual pinball machines - standard and animated backglass, with DMD screen for all games - touch screen full function (play via touch function) - Kinect 3D support with 3D gameplay without need for 3D glasses - individually programmable LED lighting - individually programmable coil, motor, fan and other functions programmed in game software

This product is only available when purchasing Arcooda Pinball Cabinets and does not function for Generic virtual pinball machines.

If you have built your own machine or purchased a machine from the marketplace, please consider the Generic software version if you do not own Pinball Arcade game titles, or, if you already own the 76 game titles in your Steam PC library, please consider the cabinet mode unlock key. For more information, please also view our Frequently Asked Questions. This is a fully licensed product.

20020.product_details: Game Titles 76 Game Titles are included on the Arcooda Pinball Arcade (Arcooda Version) software package, the entire game table list is; - Addams Family, The (+ Gold*) - Al’s Garage Band Goes On a World Tour - Attack from Mars - Big Shot - Black Hole - Black Knight - Black Knight 2000 - Black Rose - Bone Busters Inc. - Bram Stoker’s Dracula - Bride of Pin•Bot (The Machine) - Cactus Canyon - Cactus Jack’s - Centaur - Centigrade 37 - Central Park - Champion Pub, The - Cirqus Voltaire - Class of 1812 - Creature from the Black Lagoon - Cue Ball Wizard - Cyclone - Diner - Doctor Who - Doctor Who: Master of Time - Dr. Dude and His Excellent Ray - Earthshaker! - Eight Ball Deluxe - El Dorado - El Dorado: City Of Gold - Elvira and the Party Monsters - F-14 Tomcat - Fireball - Firepower - Fish Tales - Frank Thomas’ Big Hurt - FunHouse - Genie - Getaway: High Speed II, The - Gladiators - Goin’ Nuts - Gorgar - Haunted House - High Speed - Hurricane - Indianapolis 500 - Jack•Bot - Jacks Open - Judge Dredd - Junk Yard - Lights…Camera…Action! - Medieval Madness - Monster Bash - No Fear: Dangerous Sports - No Good Gofers - Party Zone, The - PIN•BOT - Red & Ted’s Road Show - Rescue 911 - Safe Cracker - Scared Stiff - Space Shuttle - Star Trek: The Next Generation - Swords of Fury - Tales of the Arabian Nights - Taxi - Tee’d Off - Terminator 2: Judgment Day - Theatre of Magic - Twilight Zone - TX-Sector - Victory - Whirlwind - White Water - WHO Dunnit - Xenon Cabinet Support Not only do you get improved game play and graphics/shading, enjoy digital plunger and variable tilt game play. Backglass and DMD Support Backglass and DMD is now working with 76 Pinball Arcade game titles, making your games become alive. Your video pinball now looks and feels like a real pinball machine. New Camera Angles for Video Pinball 4 New camera angles have been added – totally designed for full sized pinball tables. 3D Kinect Support 3D game play without glasses? Yes, just plug in your XBOX One Kinect into your PC (Windows 10/11 needed) to enjoy even more game variety on all 76 game tables. Touch Screen and Regular Play Arcooda was the first to introduce touchscreen video pinball to the commercial market, and with enhanced features, enjoy using both touch screen game play (or navigation) as well as regular pinball plunger and flipper button play – the choice is yours. Coil, LED Lighting, and Shaker Functions Through the advanced Arcooda power management board and the Arcooda Choreo software system, take full control of Arcooda Pinball Arcade software and unleash the power of your Arcooda Pinball – pinball coils, shaker motor and individually programmed LED lighting effects will make your Arcooda pinball machine feel like a real pinball machine. Stand-Alone Plug and Play Software An individual software package that does not require an internet connection or Steam Account to play the 76 included games. Simply install and play on any Arcooda brand pinball compatible cabinet.
